headline: OpenAI's 5.6-Luna climbs 32 ranks in a month
summary: OpenAI's gpt-5.6-luna-20260709 vaulted into the top 3 with 7.4% share, up from rank 35 a month ago—a stunning 30-day surge. DeepSeek still commands the market at 26.6%, while Tencent holds second at 16.6%. Two new models entered the rankings today, and two older ones dropped out.
highlights: OpenAI/gpt-5.6-luna-20260709 jumped 32 ranks in 30 days, now at rank 3 with 7.4% token share
DeepSeek maintains dominance at 26.6% provider share; OpenAI overall climbed to 12.2%
